selectedOperations.capability: internal delivery resolution when export needs it

deferredCapabilities.reason: The only enhanced-workspace collection candidate requires both contentSpaceOrFolderIds and queryTerm, so the schema does not evidence deterministic unfiltered enumeration.
The schema has direct variant get/create/update operations but no independent variant collection endpoint or stable variant collection on the content document.
Export depends on bounded content enumeration and remains deferred with list content.

defectEvidence.subject: search items
defectEvidence.finding: ManagedContentSearchResultItemsCollection.items uses oneOf directly where the prose describes a list; selected generation must normalize it to an array only after a focused transform fixture reproduces the defect.

defectEvidence.subject: dynamic content bodies
defectEvidence.finding: Content body schemas use object/additionalProperties shapes and examples contain nested heterogeneous values; selected generation must retain unknown plus runtime validation rather than fabricate DTO fields.

defectEvidence.subject: variant update multipart
defectEvidence.finding: putManagedContentVariant accepts multipart/form-data and describes contentBody as a string while examples show an object; selected generation must preserve this ambiguity for explicit validation.

defectEvidence.subject: comma-separated query serialization
defectEvidence.finding: Several query parameters are arrays whose descriptions require comma-separated wire values; transport serialization needs selected-operation metadata rather than generic repeated-key behavior.

defectEvidence.subject: collection and map candidates
defectEvidence.finding: channels, delivery contents, references, referencesList, and contentNodes require selected-operation reachability checks in 0G1; no transform is applied during semantic intake.
